steps: Establish the current v5 completion record and accepted bounded review as the baseline. Before editing, preserve coverage.json, result.md and progress.md under a fresh proposal-local evidence directory and record their hashes. Record the accepted review in progress.md, within 600 words. Preserve all earlier versioned evidence and protected files.

Inspect only the mapping-related evidence needed for MC07/G12: manuscript concept relationships and aggregation rules; the P06 context/chronology specification; MappingRule, compatible_context, map_components, check_partition and combine_partitions; their relevant tests; and retained P06 conformance and review records. Check implementation/test hashes against retained execution evidence before describing behavior as tested. Use exact line ranges, quotes and JSON pointers.

Save a substantive p15-mapping-reconciliation-v6.md and matching JSON claim ledger under docs/plans/accounting-proposal/. Organize the assessment around mapping relationships and applicability; composition and ambiguity; context and gross/net compatibility; finite disjoint/exhaustive partitions and residuals; alternative classifications of one population; and company extensions over time. For each group distinguish manuscript specification, implemented behavior, retained test evidence, unsupported behavior and the remaining proposal obligation. Save completed groups before inspecting the next group.

Resolve each original G12 obligation explicitly. Determine what existing evidence demonstrates about equal quantities with different labels, unlike measurements with similar labels, dated mappings, perimeter changes and overlapping classifications. Distinguish user-supplied finite membership from evidence that real disclosures form a valid partition. Do not equate provenance strings with accounting authority or a rejected conversion with a specified conversion method. Where evidence is absent, state the precise missing worked case, rule or decision; do not implement it.

Update only the MC07 and G12 rows in coverage.json, plus necessary source_evidence/audit_note links. Replace generic remaining-work text with evidence-backed obligations and concrete design consequences. Select statuses from inspected support without declaring whole-product closure. Preserve the other 51 rows, historical-phase dispositions, initial-profile alternatives and open decisions. Keep earlier assessment files unchanged and identify the new reconciliation as superseding only these two current assessments. Update result.md and progress.md with actual scope, findings, changed files and residuals.

Validate the final documents using a compact task-local integrity record, without creating another product test suite or rerunning historical P06 generators. Require exactly 35 unique requirement IDs and 18 unique gap IDs; only MC07/G12 assessment changes; valid paths, hashes and anchors for every new reference; agreement between the two rows and their claim ledger; and unchanged protected/versioned evidence. Preserve v5 reports as historical records: resolve their changed coverage/result/progress inputs to exact before-images rather than rewriting old hashes or exempting active dependencies. Run python3 -B scripts/check_accounting_proposal.py --phase P15 --check once on final inputs, capturing nonempty JSON and actual process metadata in fresh proposal-local filenames. Require exit 0, passed=true and errors=[].

Create a fresh bounded completion record last, pinning final deliverables, reconciliation documents, validation/checker outputs, historical-input mappings and the exact changed-file inventory. Stop after both rows have substantive supported assessments and specific remaining obligations, checks pass, and all outputs exist. Return PARTIAL for the phase with review_scope=bounded_partial_work and full P15 acceptance pending. Reserve the final 120 seconds for checks and response. If provenance or substantive uncertainty prevents completion, preserve the finished sections and name the exact remaining repair; do not expand into authority research, lifecycle design, other rows or product code.
